protocol: Invalid descriptors remain ordered local completions and never assert DataMover command valid. Pause, abort, reset, tag ordering, command stability, and completion stability regressions pass.
scope_limit: Module behavioral and synthesized OOC evidence only; vendor DataMover IP and board behavior are not proven.
